description: This PHP class 'DetailsToExpand' provides functionality to convert custom Confluence markup into expanded HTML snippets. It processes special tags, handles CDATA sections, and transforms specific macro structures into HTML elements for rendering purposes.

classes.name: DetailsToExpand
classes.description: A class responsible for converting Confluence macro markup into HTML, handling namespace conversions, CDATA sections, and macro transformations.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Transforms input content by converting namespace tags, extracting and restoring CDATA sections, parsing HTML, identifying 'details' macros, and converting them into expandable HTML segments.

methods.name: findSummary
methods.description: Searches within a DOM element for a child called 'summary' and returns it if found.

methods.name: isWithinCodeBlock
methods.description: Checks whether a given DOM element is nested inside a code macro block to avoid unintended conversions.

methods.name: convertOne
methods.description: Converts a single 'details' macro element into an 'expandable' macro with title and body, unless it is within a code block or lacks a summary.
